references.text: Describes the completion of the Nazirite vow and the regulations that apply when the period of consecration is over
Concerns special vows to the Lord and how both men and women may make such vows
Samson was dedicated as a Nazirite from birth, an example of the Nazirite vow in practice
The angel explains that the child shall be a Nazirite of God from birth until his death
Hannah's vow to give Samuel to the Lord, and that no razor should come upon his head
The prophet Amos mentions the Nazirites whom God raised up among the children of Israel
Paul cut his hair at Cenchreae because of a vow, possibly a Nazirite vow
Four men had a vow on them, and Paul was asked to purify himself with them
